experiments.person_notes: Allan Andales, Richard Carlson, Bill Batchelor, and Joel Paz
experiments.institution: Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering,Iowa State University, Ames, Iowa
experiments.local_name: BARE SOIL TEMPERATURE STUDY, AMES, IOWA
experiments.tr_notes:
This was a bare soil temperature study conducted from for 10 years from 1982 to 1990 and
in 1995 at the ISU Agronomy Research Center. Soil temperature was measured at depths
of 6.4, 10, 20,51, and 102 cm. Dr. Richard Carlson (Agronomy, ISU) provided the data.
Andales, A. A., W. D. Batchelor, and C. E. Anderson. 2000. Modification of a soybean 
model to improve soil temperature and emergence date prediction. 
Transactions of the ASAE 43(1):121-129.
